description_en: Queries the log status of protected objects
description_zh: 查询防护对象日志状态
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-resource-log-status --instance-id waf-cn-zz11zcl0000 --resources alb-wewbb23dfsetetcic1242-00000,alb-wewbb23dfsetetcic1242-10000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeResourceLogStatus

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html to query the ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html查询当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The protected objects to query. Separate multiple protected objects with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的防护对象，多个防护对象用英文逗号（,）隔开
parameters.name: resources

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud resource group ID
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

items.description_en: The log status information of the protected object
items.description_zh: 防护对象日志状态信息

Status.description_en:
The log enabling status of the protected object. Valid values:
 
true: Logging is enabled.

false: Logging is disabled
Status.description_zh:
防护对象日志开启状态。取值：
 
true：表示已开启。

false：表示未开启

RatePerMille.description_en: The per-mille sampling ratio for Tracing Analysis
RatePerMille.description_zh: 链路追踪千分位采样率

TraceStatus.description_en:
The Tracing Analysis status. Valid values:
 
true: Tracing Analysis is enabled.

false: Tracing Analysis is shutdown
TraceStatus.description_zh:
链路追踪状态。取值：
 
true：表示开启。

false：表示关闭
